description: This file contains functions for reading and extracting specific sections from a markdown file (AGENTS.md) within a workspace, used for post-compaction context injection in an auto-reply system. It includes logic for handling section headers, date formatting, and boundary file operations.

methods.name: readPostCompactionContext
methods.description: Reads critical sections from AGENTS.md for post-compaction injection, returning formatted system event text or null if no relevant sections are found.

methods.name: extractSections
methods.description: Extracts named sections from markdown content, matching headers case-insensitively and skipping fenced code blocks.
